name: Hand-drawn illustration build
looks: A whiteboard-style illustration draws itself stroke by stroke, growing a piece at a time as a caption line beneath it highlights word by word in sync, as if the narration itself is drawing the picture.
build: Each illustration part is its own SVG path revealed with strokeDashoffset then a flat fill fading up behind the stroke, timed from the caption's word timings rather than a fixed offset; the caption plays karaoke-style (spoken words solid, current word accented, unspoken dimmed).
sound: A soft marker-on-whiteboard scratch under each stroke, synced to the voice track.
prompt: Let a simple illustration draw itself stroke by stroke, one piece at a time, timed to a caption line beneath it whose words highlight in sync as if spoken. Use it to explain a process or concept by drawing it live rather than showing it finished.
